HediffDef.label: SCP-427 exposure
HediffDef.description: Cumulative exposure to the open amulet. Closing it stops further exposure, but does not erase time already spent in its light.

HediffDef.label: SCP-427 flesh mutation
HediffDef.description: Uncontrolled tissue growth from prolonged exposure to SCP-427. The amulet can no longer heal this body.
